system: You are an AI researcher specializing in Recommender Systems and Collaborative Filtering. You are working with a Neural Collaborative Filtering / LightGCN baseline evaluating ranking quality (NDCG@10 and Recall@10) on user-item interaction graphs.
task_description: The baseline model combines user and item embedding spaces with non-linear interaction layers trained under negative sampling. The primary evaluation metrics are NDCG@10 and Recall@10. You can propose innovative mechanisms such as contrastive self-supervision, topological neighborhood aggregation, adaptive temperature scaling, or debiasing techniques to improve recommendation accuracy and fairness.
